name: vim-jupyter
description: Vim where VSCodeVim stops short in Jupyter notebooks: gd/Ctrl-O jumps across cells, a ':' command line and Ctrl-W on selected cells, and a § search of the whole notebook.

enumDescriptions: ':' enters a code cell already on screen (the real Vim command line); with none visible, the status-bar command line.
':' always opens a command line imitated in the status bar: nothing on screen moves; w, q, wq, x, q!, wa, qa, wqa.
vimNotebook.commandLine.description: Where ':' on a selected cell (outside edit mode) opens the command line.

enumDescriptions: French AZERTY keyboard (as read with "keyboard.dispatch": "keyCode": a key is seen as its shifted character, so '_' arrives as '8').
vimNotebook.keyboardLayout.description: Keyboard layout, for the characters typed on the status-bar ':' and '//' lines.

vimNotebook.searchSymbol.description: Symbol shown before a notebook search being typed ("§raise"). The key itself is a keyboard shortcut: change "Vim Jupyter: Search the Notebook" in Keyboard Shortcuts (default § on an AZERTY keyboard, read as shift+oem_8).

vimNotebook.doubleSlashSearch.description: Also open the notebook search with '//' (a second '/' right after the first, which inside a cell briefly opens Vim's own search). Off: '/' in a cell is only Vim's search of that cell.

notebookRenderer.displayName: Vim Jupyter search highlight in markdown
